RESY Maker

Source: vignettes/articles/maker.Rmd
maker.Rmd

Build an expert system: each vegetation type gets a rule of conditions on species groups. As you build, RESY classifies a set of test plots with it. Export the system for the RESY App or resy_classify(). Runs in this browser tab through webR; nothing is uploaded.
